description.en: This module extends the trajecto ontology with concepts for analyzing movement patterns and behavior independent of purpose.

publisher.value: i-Lab, Department of Cultural Technology and Communication, University of the Aegean

definition.value: A distinct, identifiable pattern in how a person or group moves through space over time.

comment.en: A recognizable pattern in movement behavior.
